claims: Artemis II is currently targeted to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026, according to NASA and SpaceNews.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket returned to Launch Complex 39B on March 20, 2026, to prepare for Artemis II.
Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day crewed flight around the Moon.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket was rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) in late February 2026 to address a helium seal issue.
The mission goal of Artemis II is a 10-day crewed test flight around the Moon.
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
